parameters.name: Event
parameters.description:
The event.

Valid values: SignIn, SignOut, Break, Ready, Ringing, Talking, Abandon, End, Processing, RequestHelp, HelpSuccess, ConferenceEstablished, ConferenceEnded, and Dialing.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center instance from which to retrieve agent information.

parameters.name: RamId
parameters.description: The RAM ID of the agent.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start time.

The default value is one hour before the current time. The query time range must be less than one hour. Otherwise, an error is returned.

parameters.name: StopTime
parameters.description: The end time. Default value: the current time.
